title: Quality Bulletin: Spare Infusion Sets After Product Defects on the Insulin Pump Program
content:
**Clause.** On an Insulin Pump Program, spare sets on an infusion-set (A4224) refill follow the program's product-defect replacements of infusion sets:

- where two or more product-defect replacements of infusion sets shipped in the 12 months (the defect lookback) before the ship date, 10 spare sets (the two-defect spares) are added to the sets shipped;
- where exactly one did, 5 spare sets (the one-defect spares) are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

**What is counted.** Only replacement packages of A4224 infusion sets sent as a product-defect replacement — supplies that were defective as shipped — whose ship date falls in the 12 months before the ship date of the refill, that is, later than the same day of the month 12 months before it. Replacements for a lost, damaged-in-transit or not-received package are not product-defect replacements.

| Product-defect replacements of infusion sets in the 12 months before the ship date | Sets added |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 5 |
| 2 or more | 10 |

*Boundary reading (hypothetical):* with a ship date of 10 March, a product-defect replacement shipped on 11 March of the previous year is counted; one shipped on 10 March of the previous year is not.
